entry.title: Heavy Snow Watch
entry.summary: Periods of heavy snow above 600 metres, where snowfall amounts may approach warning criteria, and lesser amount down to 400 metres. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Heavy Rain Watch
entry.summary: Heavy rain is expected to spread north during Wednesday morning and afternoon, and amounts may approach warning criteria. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Heavy Rain Watch
entry.summary: Heavy rain is spreading northwards this evening and overnight into Wednesday. Rainfall accumulations may approach warning criteria. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow is expected to develop above 500 metres late Wednesday night. Expect 2 to 5 cm of snow to accumulate during Thursday morning near the summit and lesser amounts down to 500 metres.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow is expected to lower to 500 metres early Wednesday afternoon. 3 to 5 cm of snow may accumulate above 700 metres, with lesser amounts lower down to 500 metres. The heaviest falls are likely between midday and 8pm Wednesday.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: The snow level is expected to lower to 400 metres during Wednesday afternoon. 5 to 10 cm of snow could accumulate above 600 metres, with lesser amounts down to 400 metres. The heaviest falls are likely during the afternoon and evening with lighter falls after midnight.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow may affect the road from Wednesday morning until late afternoon. Up to 1 cm of snow may accumulate at the tunnel entrance, with lesser amounts down to 700 metres.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: The snow level is expected to lower to 400 metres during Wednesday evening. From Wednesday evening until dawn on Thursday, 5 to 8 cm of snow could accumulate near the summit, with lesser amounts down to 400 metres.
